column4: The Online Application & Enrollment Procedure for New College Freshmen involves 8 steps:   1. Register on the application portal at ums.icct.edu.ph.   2. Pay the Application Fee using your application number and name (waived for SHS Grade 11 applicants).   3. Submit admission requirements (Proof of Payment, SHS Report Card, Form 137A, Original Copy of Certificate of Good Moral Character) to the Admissions Office, Mon-Sat, 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM.   4. Receive Tentative Class Schedule (TCS) and pay down payment or full cash amount at authorized centers.   5. Activate Student Portal using Student ID as username and LAST NAME in ALL CAPS as password.   6. Generate and download your Official Registration Form (ORF) from the portal.   7. Attend the New Student Orientation.   8. Process and claim your Student ID and Library Card at the Library Department.

Submit requirements (Proof of payment, SHS Grade 12 Report Card, Form 137A, Original Good Moral Character) to the Admissions Office.   4. Receive Tentative Class Schedule (TCS) and pay down payment or full cash.   5. Activate Student Portal (Username: Student ID, Password: LAST NAME in ALL CAPS).   6. column4: Enrollment for Transferees and Second Course students involves an 11-step process:   1. Complete online application at ums.icct.edu.ph.   2. Receive confirmation via registered email.   3. Access portal and change password.   4. Pay Application Fee using Application Number as reference.   5. Submit required documents every Saturday (8:00 AM to 4:00 PM) at the Admissions Office in a long brown envelope labeled with Full Name, Application, and Contact Number. Requirements include: Letter of Intent, Original Transcript of Records (TOR)/Certificate of Grades, Original Honorable Dismissal or Certificate of Transfer, online application copy, and two photocopies of PSA Birth Certificate.   6. Evaluation takes 5 to 7 working days.   7. Settle Down Payment; receive Student ID via text within 2-3 banking days.   8. Log in to Student Portal.   9. Click 'Official Registration & Assessment' to download the ORF.   10. Attend orientation.   11. Process Student ID and Library Card at the Library (Mon-Sat, 7 AM - 7 PM).

column4: Senior High School (SHS) applicants can enroll online or walk-in. Steps include:   1. Apply via ums.icct.edu.ph or visit a campus for assistance (Mon-Sat, 7 AM to 7 PM).   2. Pay a one-time Grade 11 Registration Fee of ₱370 using your application number and full name.   3. Submit requirements: Proof of Payment, Junior High School (Grade 10) Report Card SF9, Certificate of Good Moral Character, and 2 photocopies of JHS Certificate of Completion.   4. Receive Tentative Class Schedule (TCS). Payees/ESC Grantees must pay a ₱1,000 downpayment or full cash amount (SHS Voucher Grantees disregard fee assessment).   5. Activate Portal (Username: Student ID, Password: LAST NAME in capital letters).   6. Download your Official Registration Form (ORF) from the portal.   7. Attend Orientation.   8. Visit the Library Department to process Student ID/Library Card (Mon-Sat except holidays, 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM).
